items.title: Reach Capital raises $265M Fund V to back AI founders building to ‘expand human potential’
items.summary: Reach Capital announced Tuesday an oversubscribed $265M Fund V.

items.title: Fairphone is launching its latest repairable phone in the US too
items.summary: The Fairphone 6+ is priced at $649 and will be available on Amazon.

items.title: Einride strikes deal to add 500 Tesla Semis to its fleet
items.summary: Einride will buy the Tesla Semis, which will be made to Amazon and other customers.

items.title: Detroit startup Grounded raises $5M to customize electric and gas-powered vans
items.summary: The company has shifted from making van-life builds to custom outfitting vehicles for small businesses, all while the EV landscape in the US changed dramatically.

items.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
items.summary: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in two months.

items.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
items.summary: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.

items.title: ‘Unprecedented’ number of Apple users received recent spyware alert, say investigators
items.summary: Cybersecurity experts who investigate spyware attacks say the number of people who received a recent threat notification from Apple is unusually high.

items.title: Save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until August 21
items.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

items.title: Spotify’s new Playlist Notes let users and editors explain their song picks
items.summary: Spotify launches a new feature that gives users a chance to explain the stories and reasoning behind their favorite music. Editors will be using the feature, too, on top playlists like RapCaviar and others.

items.title: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B, quadrupling its valuation in 8 months to $5.4B
items.summary: Higgsfield, founded by former Snap exec Alex Mashrabov, lets users create AI images and videos.

items.title: Reddit begins testing a new audio and video experience, similar to popular TikTok videos
items.summary: Reddit is beginning to test video and audio versions of popular posts, allowing users to watch or listen to Reddit stories instead of just reading them.

items.title: Sound-powered fire protection startup gets $15M to snuff out fires before they turn catastrophic
items.summary: Sonic Fire Tech raised its new funding to help get its sound-powered fire protection system into everything from commercial kitchens to apartment buildings.

items.title: YouTube will now count a view as soon as a video starts playing
items.summary: The change comes a year after YouTube applied the same approach to counting views on Shorts videos.

items.title: Feedly attributes weeklong slowdown to bug, not its AI pivot
items.summary: Feedly says a bug is behind the performance issues that have made its web app nearly "unusable" for some users, while complaints about its mobile apps and customer support are adding to frustrations.

items.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
items.summary: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.

items.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
items.summary: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

items.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
items.summary: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.

items.title: Terra Industries closes $52M seed round to build defense infrastructure for the Global South
items.summary: African defense tech company Terra Industries announced an additional $18 million in funding, bringing its seed round to $52 million.

items.title: WordPress.com targets the next generation of web creators with a free student plan
items.summary: WordPress.com Education lets teachers offer their students free domains, plug-in support, and professional website-building tools.

items.title: Uber adds Zipline drones to its Eats delivery network
items.summary: Uber is also making investing in Zipline a part of the tie-up.
